title: straddle.yaml
description: Distributable feature/app unit that spans firmware + browser. See docs/plans/straddles.md.

schema_version.description: Schema revision; reserved for future evolution.

name.description: Canonical <org>/<repo> identity. Matches the github path.

prefix.description: Short identity used as symbol prefix, include subdir, browser import name. May be empty (only spangap-core uses the empty prefix by convention).

version.description: Semver-ish version string. Pin-only for now; no version-range solver.

firmware.description: Firmware-half path relative to manifest dir. Omit for default 'idf'. Use '.' when the manifest dir IS the firmware project root (buildable straddles).

browser.description: Browser-half path relative to manifest dir. Omit for default 'browser'.

platforms.description: Which build platforms this straddle's firmware half supports. Today: just idf.

requires.description: Other straddles this one HARD-depends on — every build that pulls in this straddle must also pull in these. Each entry is '<org>/<repo>' optionally followed by '@<ref>' (tag/branch/SHA). A missing requires: target is a build error.

optional_requires.description: Other straddles this one integrates with WHEN PRESENT — pruned silently from the build if absent (because they weren't cloned, because the buildable doesn't list them, or because --exclude/--no-X dropped them). Source code must gate corresponding call sites on the auto-generated CONFIG_STRADDLE_<UPPER_NAME> (or the CONFIG_SPANGAP_LCD/CONFIG_SPANGAP_WEB shortcuts) so absence compiles away cleanly.

init.description: Boot init hooks this straddle wants the buildable to run automatically. spangap-inside collects these across the staged set and generates staging/spangap_init_dispatch.gen.cpp — a spangapInitStraddles() that calls them in two bands: first spangap's own platform components (core, net, web, lcd) in that fixed order, then every other straddle in dependency-topo order (a straddle inits after the straddles it requires:). There is no per-hook order knob — a straddle that must come up after another declares it in requires:/optional_requires: and the topo walk handles it; everything in the straddle band can already assume the platform band is up. Within one straddle, hooks fire in listed order. The buildable calls spangapInitStraddles() once; from then on, staging a straddle that declares init: is enough to have it initialize — no consumer main.cpp edit. Each entry's `call` is a plain global `void <name>()` defined in this straddle's firmware half (the dispatcher emits its own C++-linkage forward declaration, so no header wiring and no `extern "C"` is needed).

call.description: Init function symbol, e.g. 'sshdInit'. A plain global `void <name>()` (default C++ linkage) defined in this straddle's firmware half — the same convention every straddle's xInit() already follows. The dispatcher forward-declares it with C++ linkage and calls it, so no header wiring and no `extern "C"` wrapper is needed (a C-linkage symbol from a .c file would need one to match).

buildable.description: Top-level config for straddles that build a flashable device image. Its presence is the flag we key on to decide what's buildable — library / feature straddles omit this block entirely.

partition_layout.description: Either a path to partitions.csv relative to firmware dir, or a named platform-provided layout.

ota_pubkey.description: Path to OTA public-key PEM, relative to firmware dir.
